_design: SHAPE-CHANGING RHYTHM (user principle: every gimmick must force a leg-shape change). The required leg cycles SHORT(tunnel) → LONG(gap/planks/stairs) so the player redraws at almost every beat. STAIRS are GENTLE + LENGTH-gated (riser 0.5u): ANY sufficiently-long leg climbs (no fragile hook-shape gate — the angle/sharpness metric could not tell a hand-drawn hook from a round arc, so it wrongly rejected real hooks and the user 'couldn't climb'); a TOO-SHORT leg can't reach the next tread ⇒ jams (redraw longer — the shape-change beat right after the tunnel's short leg). The real anti-slide fix is the STEPPED-BODY-DRIVE: the cube's stand level eases to the tread directly under it (한 칸씩, hold-then-rise per tread) so it STEPS up tread-by-tread for EVERY leg shape (float <0.7u, zero penetration) instead of sliding smoothly up the hypotenuse (the user's repeated complaint). The gentle riser keeps the float small. balls/blocks/bumps are no-gate TEXTURE breathers. Each stairs run is paired with a matched DOWN ramp so the vertical profile stays bounded.

segments._note: START lead-in — run straight, draw the first leg.
SHORT — low ceiling; a long leg's sweep strikes it, must draw a short leg.
LONG — leap the V-trench; a short leg drops in and crawls (slow).

STAIRS climb (계단형) — GENTLE + length-gated. riser 0.5u / run ~1.08u. ANY sufficiently-long leg climbs (the user's hook, a long leg, etc. — no fragile hook-shape gate that rejected hand-drawn hooks); a TOO-SHORT leg can't reach the next tread ⇒ jams (redraw longer — the shape-change beat after the tunnel's short leg). The GENTLE riser (0.5) + the stepped-body-drive make the cube STEP tread-by-tread (its stand level eases to the tread directly under it = 한 칸씩, float <0.7u, zero penetration) instead of sliding up the hypotenuse — the fix for the user's slide complaint, for EVERY leg shape.
recovery DOWN ramp (slope 0.4, descending ⇒ NOT gated). Matched to the stairs rise so the vertical profile stays bounded.
ICE gimmick REMOVED per user request — was a slippery 'ice' segment; replaced with flat (same length) so the course/finishX is unchanged. Ice engine code kept dormant.
